Chana Masala

Ingredients (serves 4)
- 2 (400g) cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed
- 3 tbsp ghee
- 1 tsp cumin seeds
- 1 large onion, finely chopped
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 inch ginger, grated
- 2 green chilies, slit
- 2 tomatoes, pureed
- 1 tsp turmeric
- 2 tsp ground coriander
- 1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder
- 1 tsp garam masala
- 1 cup water
- 1 tsp salt
- 2 tbsp chopped cilantro
- Juice of ½ lemon

Directions
Heat the ghee in a heavy pan and add the cumin seeds.
When they sizzle, add the onion and cook until golden, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and chilies, then the tomato puree and spices.
Add the chickpeas and water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Finish with garam masala, lemon juice and cilantro.
